channel.title: Deep Press Analysis — English Feed
channel.description: In-depth research into corporate power, global governance, and economic dependencies.

item.title: Deep Press Analysis — August 11, 2026
item.description: A strategic reconstruction of the late-2026 global landscape reveals the collapse of traditional state hegemony and its replacement by transnational infrastructure monopolies. We analyze the hidden realities behind Middle Eastern military exhaustion, the physical monopolization of AI, and the commercial capture of US institutions.

item.title: Deep Press Analysis — August 10, 2026
item.description: Strategic assessment of institutional and cognitive frames in global media. Today's focus: how narratives surrounding AI, geopolitical conflicts, and migration are weaponized to legitimize techno-authoritarianism and the dismantling of democratic rights.

item.title: Deep Press Analysis — August 9, 2026
item.description: Strategic assessment of crisis arbitrage architecture. Today's focus: how institutional mega-funds weaponize macroeconomic shocks, sovereign defaults, and emergency legislation to expropriate strategic assets in Argentina, Egypt, and Sri Lanka.

item.title: Deep Press Analysis — August 8, 2026
item.description: A structural analysis of the 2025–2026 institutional consensus, revealing how state and transnational entities use semantic hijacking to legitimize the militarization of civilian budgets, privatize cyberspace, and enforce algorithmic censorship.

item.title: Deep Press Analysis — August 7, 2026
item.description: A strategic assessment of the August 2026 tectonic shifts in global macro-sovereignty. Today's focus: the transition to synthetic yield curve control, the terminal stage of fiscal dominance, and the radical fragmentation of global liquidity.

item.title: Deep Press Analysis — August 6, 2026
item.description: Analysis of 2024-2026 U.S. and EU government procurement reveals an unprecedented surge in AI surveillance, biometric databases, and data fusion platforms driven by private defense contractors.

item.title: Deep Press Analysis — August 5, 2026

item.title: Deep Press Analysis — August 3, 2026
item.description: Strategic assessment of the structural vulnerabilities in global markets amid a transition phase. We analyze the energy shock, the corporate refinancing crisis, regulatory fragmentation via CBAM and export controls, and liquidity risks within the non-bank financial sector.

item.title: Deep Press Analysis — August 2, 2026
item.description: Strategic assessment of global power reconfiguration. Today's focus: analyzing the instrumentalization of legal, economic, and military mechanisms by US elites to maintain hegemony and suppress opposition.

item.title: Deep Press Analysis — July 31, 2026
